note: mugen: modal (can/may) throughout
reden: verbal (speak/said) throughout; NOM not attested
hus: noun (house) throughout; ADV not attested
sunde: noun (sin) throughout; VRB not attested
legen: verbal (lay/place) throughout; NOM not attested
gebern: verbal (bear/beget) throughout; NOM not attested
slahen: verbal (strike/kill) throughout; NOM not attested
antwerten: verbal (answer) throughout; NOM not attested
sterben: verbal (die) throughout; NOM not attested
tragen: verbal (carry/bear) throughout; NOM not attested
beliben: verbal (remain/stay) throughout; NOM not attested
under: preposition (under/among) throughout
heilec: adjective (holy) throughout; note: heiligte form may be VRB misassignment
iht: indefinite pronoun/noun (anything/something) throughout
mitte: noun (midst/middle) throughout
gar: intensifying adverb (very/quite) throughout
soltu: contraction of solt+du (you shall); verbal modal component
sunder: conjunction (but/except/rather) throughout
sie: short form 'si' = personal pronoun (she/they)
sie: possessive form 'irn' (their/her, dat pl or acc sg m)
